name: Motorola Mobility
verdict: Lenovo acquired Motorola Mobility from Google in January 2014, making Motorola Mobility a subsidiary of Lenovo Group Limited.
note: Rating note: Although Motorola Mobility is a subsidiary of Lenovo (which has partial state stake via Legend Holdings), the direct owner is Lenovo; Lenovo has concern tier due to partial state stake (Legend Holdings ~31.4%, CAS Holdings ~29.04% leading to indirect state interest ~9%). Therefore, Motorola Mobility inherits concern tier.
